description: This file defines a Vue composable 'useNotes' that manages note data with localStorage persistence, including CRUD operations, search, and sorting.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Reads notes data from localStorage, parses, validates, and sorts it.

methods.name: saveToStorage
methods.description: Saves current notes state to localStorage.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional initial data, adds it to state, and selects it.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by id with new title/content and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id and updates selection if needed.

methods.name: selectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by id or null.

methods.name: clearAllNotes
methods.description: Clears all notes with optional confirmation.
